reasoning_evidence: EIA-860M (plant 67123 Fagus Solar Park, entity Excel Advantage Services LLC, covering BOTH queue phases): status (V) >50% construction through 2026-03 report, then (OP) Operating from the 2026-04 report with actual operating date 2025-12 (eia_history.json) -- independent federal reporting says the shared plant is already generating

Queue's own milestone history (timeline.md) shows approved-for-energization 2025-05-29 and approved-for-synchronization 2025-07-07 already achieved, but commercial-operation-approved still blank as of the 2026-06 snapshot -- consistent with EIA's Dec-2025 operating date plus an administrative/ERCOT-paperwork lag on the formal COD approval milestone
Satellite imagery (D2) shows the array substantially built out and stable by 2026-05, consistent with an operating plant since late 2025 rather than active construction

Reported COD drifted 7 times across 25 monthly snapshots (timeline.md): 2025-12-01 (held 2024-06->2024-12) -> 2026-02-11 -> 2026-02-10 -> 2025-09-26 -> 2025-10-03 -> 2026-03-15 -> 2026-05-14 -> 2026-05-20 (current) -- noisy but the drift band (2025-Q4 to 2026-Q2) brackets the EIA-reported actual operating date of 2025-12, so treat the queue's current 2026-05-20 figure as STALE/lagging rather than indicative of a real slip

Both phases (20INR0091 Phase1, 25INR0672 Phase2) share ONE EIA plant record -- EIA does not report per-phase status, so 'operating' could reflect Phase 1 alone with Phase 2 trailing; imagery could not visually distinguish a separate unbuilt Phase-2 sub-footprint (D2), and Exhibit C-1 shows both phases sharing one substation/collector system with equal unit counts (50 units each) -- no evidence either phase lags the other structurally

Independent estimate: plant achieved commercial operation in Q4 2025 (per EIA), ahead of/at the queue's still-listed 2026-05-20 date -- LOW drift risk in the sense that the project is not behind, it is arguably already operating and the queue simply hasn't caught up administratively

contractual_schedule.note: TSP is Electric Transmission Texas (ETT/AEP), NOT Oncor. Generator/DIA = Excel Advantage Services, LLC dba Misae Solar Park II. Original Agreement executed 2019-02-21 (single-phase, sponsor 'Latinoamericana de Energia'); amendment chain: Orig(2019-02-21)->1st(2019-09-12)->2nd(2020-02-26)->3rd(2020-12-03)->4th(2023-08-17, still single-phase, #20INR0091 only)->5th(2024-08-29, PHASE SPLIT creating #25INR0672 and #26INR0524)->6th(2024-11-21)->7th(2026-03-12, current). All months-from-execution-date computed off 2019-02-21. POI/substation name 'Fagus', Childress County ~8mi SE of Childress, POI at ETT's first dead-end structure outside Fagus Substation fence on ETT's 345kV line from ETT's Tesla Station -- matches queue POI text '60501 Tesla 345 kV' exactly. Exhibit C: Phase 2 = 50 units x 3.3729 MW = 168.64 MW nameplate (queue reports 166.57 MW, AC-rating rounding). All 3 phases share ONE substation per Exhibit C-1 one-line diagram -- no separate Phase 2 footprint exists to distinguish from Phase 1.
